# Léo JEGO — Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio presenting Léo JEGO, a full-stack developer, with selected projects, a structured CV, and direct contact information.

The site is built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and MUI. Léo works on clear web interfaces, business tools, APIs, automation workflows, Shopify projects, and IoT-related systems.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/): Landing page introducing Léo JEGO, his positioning, key proof points, featured projects, and contact paths.
- [Projects](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/projets): Project index with product, web, automation, Shopify, AI, and infrastructure projects.
- [CV](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/cv): Structured curriculum vitae with experience, skills, certifications, languages, education, and PDF CV access.
- [Contact](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/contact): Direct contact page with email, phone, LinkedIn, GitHub, and CV download.

## Featured Projects

- [Estimated Delivery Date](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/projets/edd-shopify): Shopify delivery-date app with business logic and merchant-side configuration.
- [Shopify Functions Workbench](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/projets/shopify-functions-workbench): Open-source local workbench for running, benchmarking, and debugging Shopify Functions before deployment.
- [Dashboard News AI](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/projets/dashboard-news-ai): News dashboard with custom filters and AI-generated summaries.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Sitemap](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for the main public pages.
- [Markdown version](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/): Send `Accept: text/markdown` to receive a Markdown representation of supported pages.
- [CV PDF](https://leo-jego.vercel.app/cv-leo-jego.pdf): Downloadable curriculum vitae.
